title: 01 · Method specialization
source:
# Compare the Int32 and Float64 specializations of the same method.
def twice(x)
  x + x
end

twice(1)
twice(1.0)

title: 02 · Union types and narrowing
source:
# The branches produce Int32 | String; is_a? narrows it inside each branch.
value = ARGV.empty? ? 1 : "a"

if value.is_a?(Int32)
  value + 1
else
  value.size
end

title: 03 · Macro-generated AST
source:
# Compare this call with the expanded AST: 3 * 3.
macro square(x)
  {{x}} * {{x}}
end

square(3)

title: 04 · Normalization
source:
# Compare +=, unless and until with their normalized AST.
x = 0
x += 1
unless x == 2
  x += 1
end
until x == 3
  x += 1
end

title: 05 · Overload resolution
source:
# Each call selects a different Def; compare this with example 01.
def scale(x : Int32)
  x * 2
end

def scale(x : Float64)
  x * 2
end

scale(1)
scale(1.0)

title: 06 · Unused methods and cleanup
source:
# The unused body is not type-checked; Cleanup removes the constant branch.
def unused(x)
  x.this_method_does_not_exist
end

if false
  0
else
  1
end

title: 07 · Structs and initialize
source:
# Follow initialize, the generated new method and the instance variable's type.
struct Point
  def initialize(@x : Int32)
  end

  def x
    @x
  end
end

Point.new(1).x

title: 08 · Before a type error
source:
# Inspect the operations recorded before the incompatible argument is rejected.
1 + "a"

title: 09 · Declarations and type hierarchy
source:
# Follow type creation, inheritance, include/extend and reopening.
module Named
  def value
    1
  end
end

class Parent
end

class Child < Parent
  include Named
  extend Named
end

class Child
  def value
    2
  end
end

Child.new.value
Child.value
